summary: Ferrovial SE filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine update on its ongoing share repurchase program that began December 15, 2025. The filing discloses transactions between March 27 and April 24, 2026, including specific purchases on US trading venues at weighted-average prices ranging from €54.59 to €57.48 per share during one period, and similar periodic disclosures in three additional press releases. As of April 2, 2026, the company had repurchased 3,396,894 shares for €196.1 million in total. No specific corporate event trigger is present; this is a regular buyback status report, not a tender offer or special capital return initiative. What to watch: continued execution of the pre-announced program.
